mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (nominal GDP) signals expanding economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite a sustained quarterly rise in GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in UNRATE exceeding 0.2 percentage points triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting heightened unemployment concerns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases >0.2 percentage points in the past month
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite UNRATE rising >0.2pp in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly rises in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) indices signal economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved growth prospects.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and INDPRO show upward trends.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in FEDFUNDS below 2.0% during a monetary tightening cycle triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, signaling potential market stress from aggressive rate hikes.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS falling below 2.0% in a tightening regime.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly growth in PAYEMS (labor employment) exceeding prior levels predicts stronger labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained PAYEMS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in GDPC1 below 11,000 billions of chained 2017 dollars triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, indicating weakening economic momentum.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls >1% in the next month
failure_condition: 60-day returns remain positive despite GDPC1 falling >1% in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: Parallel monthly increases in HOUST (demand) and RSAFS (demand) indices signal heightened consumer and business demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through expanded economic activity.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both HOUST and RSAFS rise concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO (supply) exceeding 5 percentage points in a late-cycle expansion regime triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, signaling potential overcapacity and market correction.
failure_condition: 60-day returns remain positive despite INDPRO falling >5% in the late-cycle regime.
